Policy number: HR-110
Effective: 2025-04-01
Owner: People Operations, with Workplace
Approved by: Marcus Delgado, VP People

## 1. Purpose

This policy sets out where Cardinal Energy employees work. It defines the three work arrangements, the expectations for each, and the support the company provides for working from home.

## 2. Work arrangements

Every role has one of three arrangements. Your offer letter states yours, and PeopleHub shows it on your profile.

**Hybrid.** You live within 50 miles of a Cardinal office (Oakland, Boulder, or Rotterdam) and split your time"}, {"doc_id": "people-announcement-2026-05-office-days", "title": "Announcement: Three In-Office Days for Hybrid Teams", "snippet": "In-Office Days for Hybrid Teams

Posted: 2026-05-04
From: Marcus Delgado, VP People
To: All employees

Starting 2026-06-01, hybrid employees will work from their assigned office at least 3 days each week. The anchor days will be Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.

This replaces Section 3 of the Remote and Hybrid Work Policy (HR-110, effective 2025-04-01), which set the expectation at two days with Tuesday and Thursday as anchor days. It also replaces the summary in Section 7 of the Employee Handbook. The rest of the policy stays in force.

## Why

Welcome to Cardinal Energy. This guide covers your first 90 days: what happens when, what you need to do, and who can help. Your manager has a matching checklist in PeopleHub.

## Before your first day

- You will receive an email from People Operations with a link to PeopleHub. Complete your tax forms, your direct deposit details, and your emergency contact there.
- IT ships a laptop to remote employees so that it arrives in the week before the start date. Hybrid and on-site employees collect their laptop on the first morning.
- Your manager will send you your"}, {"doc_id": "employee-handbook", "title": "Cardinal Energy Employee Handbook", "snippet": "employees of Cardinal Energy, Inc. in the United States. Employees in the Rotterdam office follow this handbook except where the Netherlands addendum, published on Perch, says otherwise.

## 1. Welcome

Welcome to Cardinal Energy. We build software and devices that help electric utilities understand what is happening on their distribution grids. Our customers are investor-owned utilities, municipal utilities, and rural cooperatives. They use our GridLens software, our Meridian M4 meter gateways, and our Pulse S2 line sensors to forecast load, find outages, and measure losses.

Cardinal Energy"}, {"doc_id": "benefits-summary-2026", "title": "Benefits Summary, Plan Year 2026", "snippet": "employees of Cardinal Energy for the 2026 plan year. The plan documents govern if they differ from this summary. Rotterdam employees have a separate summary under the Netherlands addendum.

## Enrollment

New employees have 30 days from their start date to enroll. Coverage starts on the first day of employment. Open enrollment for the 2026 plan year ran from November 3 to November 21, 2025. Outside open enrollment you can change your elections only within 30 days of a qualifying life event.

## Health insurance

We offer three medical plans: a PPO plan, an HMO plan, and a high-deductible plan"}]
